verses.original: Ἀρχόμεθα συνιστάνειν ἑαυτοὺς πάλιν ἢ μὴ χρῄζομεν ὥς τινες ἐπιστολῶν συστατικῶν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἢ ἐξ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Archometha synistanein heautous palin ē mē chrēzomen hōs tines epistolōn systatikōn pros hymas ē ex hymōn
verses.literal: Are we beginning to commend ourselves again Or vvv do we need like some [people] letters of recommendation to you or from you

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἡμῶν ἡ ἐπιστολὴ ἐνγεγραμμένη ἐν ἡμῶν ταῖς καρδίαις γινωσκομένη καὶ ἀναγινωσκομένη ὑπὸ πάντων ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: hymeis este hēmōn hē epistolē engegrammenē en hēmōn tais kardiais ginōskomenē kai anaginōskomenē hypo pantōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: You yourselves are our - letter inscribed on our - hearts known and read by everyone . . .

verses.original: φανερούμενοι ὅτι ἐστὲ ἐπιστολὴ Χριστοῦ διακονηθεῖσα ὑφ’ ἡμῶν ἐνγεγραμμένη οὐ μέλανι ἀλλὰ Πνεύματι ζῶντος Θεοῦ οὐκ ἐν πλαξὶν λιθίναις ἀλλ’ ἐν πλαξὶν σαρκίναις καρδίαις
verses.transliteration: phaneroumenoi hoti este epistolē Christou diakonētheisa hyph’ hēmōn engegrammenē ou melani alla Pneumati zōntos Theou ouk en plaxin lithinais all’ en plaxin sarkinais kardiais
verses.literal: It is clear that you are a letter from Christ the result of our ministry . . . . . . written not with ink but with [the] Spirit of [the] living God not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts

verses.original: δὲ τοιαύτην Πεποίθησιν πρὸς τὸν Θεόν ἔχομεν διὰ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: de toiautēn Pepoithēsin pros ton Theon echomen dia tou Christou
verses.literal: - Such confidence before - God is ours through - Christ

verses.original: οὐχ ὅτι ἐσμεν ἱκανοί ἀφ’ ἑαυτῶν λογίσασθαί τι ὡς ἐξ ἑαυτῶν ἀλλ’ ἡμῶν ἡ ἱκανότης ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ouch hoti esmen hikanoi aph’ heautōn logisasthai ti hōs ex heautōn all’ hēmōn hē hikanotēs ek tou Theou
verses.literal: Not that we are competent in ourselves to claim that anything [comes] from us but our - competence [comes] from - God

verses.original: καὶ ὃς ἱκάνωσεν ἡμᾶς διακόνους καινῆς διαθήκης οὐ γράμματος ἀλλὰ πνεύματος γὰρ τὸ γράμμα ἀποκτέννει δὲ τὸ πνεῦμα ζωοποιεῖ
verses.transliteration: kai hos hikanōsen hēmas diakonous kainēs diathēkēs ou grammatos alla pneumatos gar to gramma apoktennei de to pneuma zōopoiei
verses.literal: And He has qualified us [as] ministers of a new covenant not of [the] letter but of [the] Spirit for the letter kills but the Spirit gives life

verses.original: δὲ Εἰ ἡ διακονία τοῦ θανάτου ἐντετυπωμένη ἐν γράμμασιν λίθοις ἐγενήθη ἐν δόξῃ ὥστε τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ δύνασθαι μὴ ἀτενίσαι εἰς τὸ πρόσωπον Μωϋσέως διὰ τὴν τοῦ αὐτοῦ προσώπου τὴν καταργουμένην δόξαν
verses.transliteration: de Ei hē diakonia tou thanatou entetypōmenē en grammasin lithois egenēthē en doxē hōste tous huious Israēl dynasthai mē atenisai eis to prosōpon Mōuseōs dia tēn tou autou prosōpou tēn katargoumenēn doxan
verses.literal: Now if the ministry - of death which was engraved in letters on stone came with {such} glory that the vvv Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of - vvv vvv [its] - fleeting glory

verses.original: πῶς ἔσται οὐχὶ ἡ διακονία τοῦ πνεύματος μᾶλλον ἐν δόξῃ
verses.transliteration: pōs estai ouchi hē diakonia tou pneumatos mallon en doxē
verses.literal: - will not the ministry of the Spirit {be} even more vvv glorious

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ τῇ διακονία τῆς κατακρίσεως δόξα πολλῷ μᾶλλον περισσεύει δόξῃ ἡ διακονία τῆς δικαιοσύνης
verses.transliteration: gar ei tē diakonia tēs katakriseōs doxa pollō mallon perisseuei doxē hē diakonia tēs dikaiosynēs
verses.literal: For if the ministry - of condemnation was glorious how much more . . . glorious {is} the ministry - of righteousness

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ τὸ δεδοξασμένον οὐ δεδόξασται ἐν τούτῳ τῷ μέρει εἵνεκεν τῆς δόξης ὑπερβαλλούσης
verses.transliteration: kai gar to dedoxasmenon ou dedoxastai en toutō tō merei heineken tēs doxēs hyperballousēs
verses.literal: Indeed . . . what was once glorious vvv has no glory now in - - comparison to . . . the glory [that] surpasses [it]

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ τὸ καταργούμενον διὰ δόξης πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐν δόξῃ τὸ μένον
verses.transliteration: gar ei to katargoumenon dia doxēs pollō mallon en doxē to menon
verses.literal: For if what was fading away [came] with glory how much greater . . . [is the] glory of that which endures

verses.original: οὖν Ἔχοντες τοιαύτην ἐλπίδα χρώμεθα πολλῇ παρρησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: oun Echontes toiautēn elpida chrōmetha pollē parrēsia
verses.literal: Therefore since we have such a hope we are very bold

verses.original: καὶ οὐ καθάπερ Μωϋσῆς ἐτίθει κάλυμμα ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ πρόσωπον πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ μὴ τὸ ἀτενίσαι εἰς τὸ τέλος τοῦ καταργουμένου
verses.transliteration: kai ou kathaper Mōusēs etithei kalymma epi autou to prosōpon pros tous huious Israēl mē to atenisai eis to telos tou katargoumenou
verses.literal: [We are] not like Moses [who] would put a veil over his - face to keep the vvv Israelites [from] - gazing at the end of what was fading away

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ αὐτῶν τὰ νοήματα ἐπωρώθη γὰρ ἄχρι τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας τὸ αὐτὸ κάλυμμα μένει ἐπὶ τῇ ἀναγνώσει τῆς παλαιᾶς διαθήκης μὴ ἀνακαλυπτόμενον ὅτι ἐν Χριστῷ καταργεῖται
verses.transliteration: Alla autōn ta noēmata epōrōthē gar achri tēs sēmeron hēmeras to auto kalymma menei epi tē anagnōsei tēs palaias diathēkēs mē anakalyptomenon hoti en Christō katargeitai
verses.literal: But their - minds were closed For to - [this] day the same veil remains at the reading of the old covenant vvv It has not been lifted [because] only in Christ can it be removed

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἕως σήμερον ἡνίκα ἂν Μωϋσῆς ἀναγινώσκηται κάλυμμα κεῖται ἐπὶ αὐτῶν τὴν καρδίαν
verses.transliteration: all’ heōs sēmeron hēnika an Mōusēs anaginōskētai kalymma keitai epi autōn tēn kardian
verses.literal: And even to this day when . . . Moses is read a veil covers . . . their - hearts

verses.original: δὲ ἡνίκα ἐὰν ἐπιστρέψῃ πρὸς Κύριον τὸ κάλυμμα περιαιρεῖται
verses.transliteration: de hēnika ean epistrepsē pros Kyrion to kalymma periaireitai
verses.literal: But whenever . . . [anyone] turns to [the] Lord the veil is taken away

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Κύριος ἐστιν τὸ Πνεῦμά δὲ οὗ τὸ Πνεῦμα Κυρίου ἐλευθερία
verses.transliteration: de Ho Kyrios estin to Pneuma de hou to Pneuma Kyriou eleutheria
verses.literal: Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of [the] Lord [is] [there is] freedom

verses.original: δὲ ἡμεῖς ἀνακεκαλυμμένῳ προσώπῳ πάντες κατοπτριζόμενοι τὴν δόξαν Κυρίου μεταμορφούμεθα τὴν αὐτὴν εἰκόνα ἀπὸ δόξης εἰς δόξαν καθάπερ ἀπὸ Κυρίου Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: de hēmeis anakekalymmenō prosōpō pantes katoptrizomenoi tēn doxan Kyriou metamorphoumetha tēn autēn eikona apo doxēs eis doxan kathaper apo Kyriou Pneumatos
verses.literal: And we, [who] with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of [the] Lord are being transformed into - [His] image vvv vvv vvv with intensifying glory which comes from [the] Lord [who is the] Spirit
